system.description: You're no stranger to the spotlight. Whether it's playing an instrument in a local pub, gracing the stage in a theatrical production, or any number of potential performances, you're accustomed to putting on a show.
system.bonus: Bonus Proficiency: Performance. Zeitgeist: When making a Culture or Insight check to understand the importance or meaning of a piece of art or performance, you may use Charisma instead of Wisdom.
